# Local Commander for Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, Antigravity, Kiro and LM Studio
Connects Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, Antigravity, Kiro and LM Studio to Local Commander at `https://lo
calcmd.app/mcp`. Your AI gets hands on every computer you own: it can run commands and scripts, chan
ge settings, edit files and check local services on any of them, from one chat. Your workspace at lo
calcmd.app shows which computer ran each request and how it ended.
This repository holds configuration only: a Cursor plugin, a DeepSeek Harness bundle, an Antigravity
plugin, a Kiro Power and LM Studio settings. The service runs at localcmd.app.
## Requirements

- A Local Commander account at localcmd.app.
- A Windows 11 x64 computer with Node.js 20 or later an
d the paired agent: run `npx local-commander-agent@latest` on it, then choose full access or selecte

d folders.
- The computer must be online for work and for reading results.
Once you approve a computer and connect your AI, it can do what your Windows account can do, just li
ke you at the keyboard. You can limit it to certain folders, block commands, stop running work, or s
witch a computer off from the site at any time. Every run shows which computer did it. Whatever the
AI asks for goes back to the AI.

Troubleshooting:
- **The agent reports no computers:** start the agent on the Windows computer and check that it show

s as online at localcmd.app.
- **Sign-in loops or fails:** open Output, choose "MCP Logs", and check

the OAuth error; then remove and re-add the server.
- **A result is unknown:** the computer dropped
during the task. The work is not re-run automatically; check the computer and ask again.
## DeepSeek Harness
A configuration-only DeepSeek Harness bundle. The tools appear as `mcp__local-commander__<tool>`.
The harness MCP client sends static headers only, so the bundle starts `mcp-remote` over stdio. On f
irst use it opens localcmd.app in your browser to sign in and approve access (OAuth 2.0), then keeps
the token refreshed. In your localcmd.app workspace these requests show the client name "MCP CLI Pr
oxy", the name mcp-remote registers.
DeepSeek Harness asks for Node.js 22.19 or later on the machine where you chat.

## Antigravity
This repository is also an Antigravity plugin (`.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json` plus `mcp_config.js
on`). Like the DeepSeek Harness bundle, it starts `mcp-remote` over stdio, which opens localcmd.app
in your browser to sign in and approve access (OAuth 2.0) and keeps the token refreshed. Requests sh
ow the client name "MCP CLI Proxy" in your localcmd.app workspace.
Install:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or clone the repository and run `agy plugin install <folder>`. Remove with `agy plugin uninstall loc
epository and run `agy plugin install <folder>`. Remove with `agy plugin uninstall local-commander`.
## Kiro
The `kiro-power/` folder is a Kiro Power in the Agent Plugins format (`plugin.json` and `mcp.json`).
It points Kiro at the remote server `https://localcmd.app/mcp` (Streamable HTTP), which uses OAuth
2.0 sign-in at localcmd.app.
Install: in Kiro, open the Powers panel, choose **Add Custom Power**, then **Import power from GitHu
b**, and enter `https://github.com/netbka/local-commander-plugins/tree/main/kiro-power`.
## LM Studio
LM Studio 0.3.17 or later runs MCP servers listed in its `mcp.json`. Like the DeepSeek Harness bundl
e, the entry starts `mcp-remote` over stdio, which opens localcmd.app in your browser to sign in and
approve access (OAuth 2.0) and keeps the token refreshed. Requests show the client name "MCP CLI Pr
oxy" in your localcmd.app workspace. The computer running LM Studio needs Node.js 20 or later.
